It uses [supplement], it has an understanding with humanoids because [cooperates].
Unknown to the public, This monster has [hasa]. the locals are [locals], but the villain thinks it is [thinks].
Folk still live in the Villain's domain because it offers vastly superior [benefits], and because those in the villain's favor receive special [rewards] if they can weather the Villain's perilous [hurts], as long as the don't run afoul of it, and it's [punishes].
The Villain revels in [favorite], but loathes [leastfavorite]. The greatest threat to this Villain's reign is [threatened], and the possibility of facing [fear]. The Villain's dominion has [presence], and is uniquely prepared against [resist] ever since [firstcame], which facilitated it's [rise] rise from [usedtobe] to it's current position.
Upon learning of the party, [party].
